query:
SELECT 
  (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM claims WHERE claim_number IS NULL OR claim_number = '') as claims_missing_number,
  (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM claims WHERE tenant_id IS NULL) as claims_missing_tenant,
  (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM ai_assessments a LEFT JOIN claims c ON c.id = a.claim_id WHERE c.id IS NULL) as orphan_assessments,
  (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM claim_approvals ca LEFT JOIN claims c ON c.id = ca.claim_id WHERE c.id IS NULL) as orphan_approvals,
  (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM claim_documents cd LEFT JOIN claims c ON c.id = cd.claim_id WHERE c.id IS NULL) as orphan_documents,
  (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT tenant_id) FROM claims WHERE tenant_id IS NOT NULL) as distinct_tenants_in_claims,
  (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM claims WHERE status = 'submitted' AND TIMESTAMPDIFF(HOUR, updated_at, NOW()) > 24) as stuck_submitted_24h,
  (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM claims WHERE status = 'assessment_pending' AND TIMESTAMPDIFF(HOUR, updated_at, NOW()) > 2) as stuck_assessment_2h,
  (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM claims WHERE status = 'comparison' AND TIMESTAMPDIFF(HOUR, updated_at, NOW()) > 24) as stuck_comparison_24h;
